==Description==
The '''Reanimated''' was an enemy that appeared exclusively in [[Trick or Threat Town]] as part of the [[Halloween 2020 Event]].

While the '''Reanimated''' had a slower speed compared to the [[Buried]], it had a high amount of health. This made it a major threat.

The '''Reanimated''' could be spawned by the [[Lord Sinister]].

==Appearance==
The '''Reanimated''' had green skin, with its torso and legs colored brown. Its torso and legs were slate. Its rib and right leg were cut open and exposed, similar to the [[Undead (Trick or Threat Town)|Undead]]. Bone could have been seen in these cuts. It also had a shocked face. Two bolts were connected to either side of its head. Its head was slightly tilted downwards.

==Strategy==
*Make sure to have enough towers to defeat the '''Reanimated''' when it first appears.
**Use high DPS towers such as the [[Ranger]], [[Minigunner]] and [[Turret]] to defeat the '''Reanimated'''. 
***Due to the '''Reanimated's''' high health, [[Ranger]]s are highly recommended.
***Multiple Level 3 [[Ranger]]s can easily defeat the '''Reanimated'''.
*The [[Commander]]'s ''Call to Arms'' may be useful in boosting firerate. This helps in defeating the '''Reanimated'''.
*The [[Military Base]] can be useful, if the '''Reanimated''' leaves the range of all of your towers since its health is significantly low enough to be killed by a few [[Tank (Unit)|Tanks]].

==Trivia==
*The bolts on the head of the '''Reanimated''' showed resemblance to the [[Frankenstein (Nightmare Carnival)|Frankenstein]], an enemy from the [[Halloween 2019 Event]].
*The shocked face on the '''Reanimated''' is based on the ﾟдﾟ emoticon, popularized from 2channel.
